_comment: Copy to apps.json and edit. The real file is gitignored because it holds
an Apple team ID and local repo paths.
thresholdDays  refresh when fewer than this many days remain (7-day life,
so 2 leaves several scheduled attempts of slack).
deviceUdid     optional. Omit to use whichever paired iPhone answers;
set it if more than one device is ever paired.
dir          working directory the build command runs in
build        argv of an existing signed-device build script in that repo.
It must sign for a real device, not the simulator.
searchRoot   where to hunt for the built .app (defaults to dir)
env          extra environment for the build, e.g. DEVELOPMENT_TEAM
alwaysInstall  reinstall even if the app is absent from the phone.
Default is to leave deleted apps deleted.
